items.quote: I avoided seeing anyone about my acne for years because I was embarrassed. Dr. Patel looked at my skin properly, explained what was actually happening and stopped two creams I had been using. Within three months the breakouts were under control.
Six sessions of laser on my underarms and legs. No burns, no dark patches, and I have not needed to wax in over a year. The team told me honestly that my chin would need maintenance, and it did.

I came in for hair fall expecting to be sold a transplant. Instead I got a scalp examination, blood tests and a medical plan first. My hair fall reduced in about four months and we are now doing PRP for density.
Our daughter's eczema was flaring every few weeks. Dr. Patel explained the triggers, gave us a simple routine and steroid-free options for maintenance. Her skin has been calm for months now.
